name: materialized_view
description: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW with aggregation query. NOTE: total_spent pins the CURRENT, WRONG output of the view resolver -- sum(numeric(10,2)) is numeric in PostgreSQL, not bigint, and over a GROUP BY of NOT NULL values it is not nullable either. This is issue #182 (the view resolver hardcodes aggregate types); the values here are recorded so the defect is visible rather than unasserted, and must be corrected to numeric/not-null when #182 is fixed.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id serial PRIMARY KEY, customer_id integer NOT NULL, total numeric(10,2) NOT NULL, created_at date NOT NULL)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW order_summary AS SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS order_count, sum(total) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id
